newsitem.title: USA: USDA - U.S. exporters report soyoil sold to unknown.
newsitem.headline: USDA - U.S. exporters report soyoil sold to unknown.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday private exporters reported sales of 25,000 tonnes of soybean oil to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year.
The marketing year for soyoil began Oct 1.

Exporters must report to USDA sales of 100,000 tonnes or more of one commodity, and 20,000 tonnes for soybean oil, made in one day to a single destination by 1500 ET the next business day after the sale.
Sales of lesser quantities must be reported weekly.
